title: Contact GoGloby: Expert Guidance on Global Scaling & AI Teams

zones.label: Map interactive: US-Aligned Applied AI Engineering Hubs

compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an advisor and Applied AI engineering provider, and offers a feature-cost Benchmark rather than clearly directing buyers to its recruiting and staffing services. It also makes unsupported claims about a four-week deployment timeline, overseas offices and contacts, and security certifications.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI engineering positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page positions GoGloby around global expansion advice and Applied AI engineering, rather than its approved staffing and recruiting description.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the advice and engineering-provider framing with positioning consistent with the approved company description and services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.page_value: Global expansion advice and Applied AI engineering
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

llm_problems.title: Standalone feature-cost Benchmark
llm_problems.issue: The page offers a feature-cost review as a standalone briefing, while the AI Development Intelligence Layer is bundled only with nearshore staffing and is not sold separately.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the standalone feature-cost offer or make clear that tracking is included only with Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing.
